roles.title: Design Lead (Associate Team Lead)
points: Lead a team of 12 designers, running design reviews and managing delivery across client projects that run at the same time.
Delivered 50+ end-to-end RFP design projects on schedule, from first pitch through to solutioning.
Built a three-tier design token system now used across product teams, which cut the back-and-forth between design and development.
Work with PMs, developers and BAs to settle open questions before handoff, so less comes back for rework afterwards.
Brought AI tools into the team's daily workflow to speed up production without losing quality.

roles.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
points: Redesigned the ordering flows for KFC, Pizza Hut and Hardee's, shortening the path from menu to checkout.
Ran 50+ usability testing sessions end to end, from recruiting participants through to sharing findings with clients.
Built a performance dashboard for KFC UAE and interactive PFM prototypes for Hero FinCorp, each on the client's own design system.
Handled UX and UI from first concept to developer handoff for EMAAR, Peet's Coffee, Americana Restaurants, Atomberg, ECCO, Flynas and LogiNext.

roles.title: Senior UI Designer
points: Designed the UI for Oneto11, a fantasy sports platform.
Built a library of 50+ reusable components used across teams.
Delivered UI for Instaeats, Nebula and Witly.

recognition.title: Star Performer of the Year
recognition.detail: For RFP website design that exceeded client expectations.

recognition.title: Design Thinking Workshop — Facilitator
recognition.detail: Facilitated a design thinking workshop for 100 attendees.
